subject.title: fix(cli): warn that attach --print-config prints a live bearer token

question: Is a stderr warning sufficient for `attach --print-config`, or must the command also provide a safe-by-default redacted/summary path before this issue can close?
rationale: The branch is technically coherent, but choosing whether raw live bearer output remains the default is a user-facing credential-boundary decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Require Log-Safe Mode
options.body: Keep the warning and add an explicit redacted or non-secret summary path so evidence and reports can be generated without exposing the bearer value.

options.title: Accept Warning-Only Mitigation
options.body: Land the current patch while intentionally retaining raw stdout for the documented manual copy/launch workflow.

options.title: Redesign Raw Output
options.body: Make secret-bearing output explicitly opt-in or move the credential into a protected handoff artifact, accepting the larger compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Require Log-Safe Mode
recommendation.body: Keep the warning and add an explicit redacted or non-secret summary path so evidence and reports can be generated without exposing the bearer value.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged and refined the existing attach CLI and grant security contract and was explicitly routed the decision in the PR discussion.
